On-device text recognition for the Conversation Reader's screenshot import.
Loaded only when someone picks a screenshot; screenshots are read in the browser and never uploaded.

tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js   tesseract.js 6.0.1 (https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js), Apache License 2.0
core/*.wasm.js                    tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 (https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core), Apache License 2.0
                                  (Tesseract OCR, https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract, Apache License 2.0)
lang/eng.traineddata.gz           @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int (MIT package of the Apache-2.0
                                  tessdata_best model from https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best)
tesseract.min.js also bundles regenerator-runtime (MIT, Facebook, Inc.).

The Apache License 2.0 text is in LICENSE.txt.
